title: Nuclei targeted scanning (multi-target)
description: Template-based vuln/misconfig scanning at scale with safe defaults.
detail: Use for web/services across many targets. 1) Curate target list (live URLs/hosts). 2) Start with safe templates/tags (technologies, exposures, misconfiguration, default-logins) before intrusive ones; respect scope and rate. 3) Use -severity/info filtering and -rate-limit/-c to avoid overload; exclude fragile/OT targets unless approved. 4) Triage hits: validate manually, convert confirmed issues to vuln facts. 5) Pipe httpx output into nuclei for efficiency.
